request: When max_filesize is set on the sequential walker, let every file under the limit bypass filter_entry so our size-only scans avoid callback overhead.

source.request: When max_filesize is set on the sequential walker, let every file under the limit bypass filter_entry so our size-only scans avoid callback overhead.
source.settled: The sequential walker applies filter_entry to files that pass max_filesize, matching the parallel walker.
source.why: Bypassing the callback would again include files that the custom filter rejects whenever a size limit is set.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored.
